hadith:
Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy - Narrated Abu Huraira:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Procrastination (delay) in repaying debts by a wealthy person is injustice."
message: When facing hypocrisy or injustice in others, remember that Allah is An-Naafi' (The Bestower of Benefits)—He alone provides true goodness and protection to those with sincere hearts. Just as delaying debt repayment by the wealthy is considered injustice, we must be honest and truthful in all our dealings, avoiding the emptiness of false appearances and arrogant behavior. Trust in Allah's guidance and seek His mercy, for genuine benefit comes only from upright conduct and sincere faith.
name:
An Naafi’ - النَّافِعُ - The Bestower of Benefits

The name An Naafi' highlights the divine attribute of providing benefits and positive outcomes to the believers and all of creation. It emphasizes God's mercy and generosity, reflecting His role as a source of sustenance and care for humanity and the universe.
verse:
Al-Munafiqun - The Hypocrites - 63:4-5

When you see them, their appearance impresses you. And when they speak, you listen to their ˹impressive˺ speech. But they are ˹just˺ like ˹worthless˺ planks of wood leaned ˹against a wall˺. They think every cry is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah condemn them! How can they be deluded ˹from the truth˺?

When it is said to them, “Come! The Messenger of Allah will pray for you to be forgiven,” they turn their heads ˹in disgust˺, and you see them ˹O Prophet˺ turn away in arrogance.
